name: Freedom for All Creatures
summary: The Grimtotem clan is capturing faerie dragons, and Kindal Moonweaver and Jer'kai do not know what for. Kindal asks you to bring strong friends, open the pen in the Grimtotem camp with a key and see the sprite darters out alive. Kindal comes with you; Jer'kai stays behind.

sections.title: Dragons in the Pen
sections.body: Kindal Moonweaver calls the Grimtotem clan filthy for taking faerie dragons, and says that neither Kindal nor Jer'kai can guess their plans, only that they are up to no good. The two are not strong enough to fight their way into the camp, so Kindal turns to you. The Bamboo Cage Key opens the pen, and Kindal wants the sprite darters to escape with their lives. Strong friends at your side are welcome.

sections.title: Kindal's Lookout
sections.body: Kindal is found on the ledge behind the Grimtotem Compound, above the water, reached by a path up the cliff face. Kindal fights beside you through the camp, while Jer'kai stays behind.

sections.title: Afterward
sections.body: Once the darters are free, Kindal gives thanks to Elune. The danger has not ended: freed dragons will not necessarily stay free, so Kindal and Jer'kai mean to take the fight to the Grimtotem. Kindal sends you to speak with Jer'kai.

faq.q: Who is capturing the faerie dragons?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem clan, according to Kindal Moonweaver. What they want with the dragons, Kindal and Jer'kai cannot say.

faq.q: What do I need to free the sprite darters?
faq.answer: The Bamboo Cage Key, which Kindal gives you, opens the pen in the Grimtotem camp. Kindal wants you to bring strong friends.
